questions.q: Explain why chlorine has a low boiling point.
questions.a: Simple molecular (1); weak intermolecular forces need little energy to overcome (1)
questions.model: Type: simple molecular. What breaks on boiling? Weak forces between molecules, not covalent bonds. Little energy needed.

questions.q: Draw the dot-and-cross diagram for MgO (outer shells).
questions.a: Mg²⁺ with empty outer shell (or 8 in second), O²⁻ with 8 outer electrons (6 dots + 2 crosses), charges shown

Big question: why does salt melt at 801 °C but chlorine boils at -34 °C?
questions.a: Salt: strong ionic bonds throughout; chlorine: weak intermolecular forces.
